name: Kimajime Fuuki Iinchou no Ura Account ~Mebaete Shimatta Midara na Shounin Yokkyuu~
original_name: 生真面目風紀委員長の裏アカウント ～芽生えてしまった淫らな承認欲求～
source:
Nanako peeked at the school’s underground forum.
She was well aware that her serious, inflexible nature made her stand out—and not in a good way. She expected there’d be some insults and criticism aimed at her, but that didn’t mean it wouldn’t hurt.

But what she found on the forum was…

“The discipline committee president has such a sexy body, huh?”
“Her personality’s a mess, but her figure’s top-tier lol.”
“If she stripped, everyone’d lose their minds…”

Words like these jumped out at her.
Nanako, the strict and uncompromising discipline committee president, couldn’t stand anything crooked or dishonest. Yet, a twisted desire began to take root in her heart. Where would it lead her?

The thrill of being seen, the pleasure of being desired…
Once you know it, there’s no going back.

translation:
奈奈子偷偷点开了学校的地下论坛。

她知道，自己一本正经、认死理的脾气在学校里很惹眼，也招人讨厌。她猜得到会有人骂她、说她的坏话，可就算有心理准备，看见了还是会难受。

然而，论坛上说的却是…

“风纪委员长身材挺性感的嘛。”
“性格烂透了，身材倒是一流，哈哈。”
“她要是脱了，大家还不疯掉…”

这样的话，一句句跳进她眼里。
奈奈子是个眼里揉不得沙子的风纪委员长，凡事都要讲规矩、辨是非。可现在，一种扭曲的渴望悄悄在她心底扎了根。这份渴望会把她带往何处？

被人注视时的心跳，被人渴望时的喜悦…
一旦尝过，就再也回不去了。
